description: A small, fast code editor written in Go, with a native GPU-drawn UI
notes: The official Windows build is an NSIS installer that unpacks into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Mayoi; Scoop unpacks the same archive tree instead and the app starts from the Scoop directory.

Mayoi keeps its settings, window state, sessions and crash logs in %APPDATA%\Mayoi. Its self-updater cannot write to the Scoop directory, so it never updates this copy - update with 'scoop update mayoi'. Scoop uninstall removes neither this folder nor the two it names next - delete them to clean up completely.

The 'mayoi' command comes from Scoop's shim; skip Mayoi's own Command Palette command "Install 'mayoi' Command", which writes %LOCALAPPDATA%\Mayoi\bin and adds it to the user PATH, both of which outlive 'scoop uninstall'. Remove that command, and the user PATH entry, from the same Command Palette first.

The 'Open with Mayoi' Explorer context menu (HKCU\Software\Classes\*|Directory|Directory\Background\shell\dev.mayoi.editor) and a Start Menu shortcut are only created by the installer, not by the archive.
